name: Standard Chess
desc: Classic FIDE rules. The foundation everything else is built on.

name: King of the Hill
desc: Move your king to the centre four squares for an instant win.

name: Three-Check
desc: Deliver three checks to win. No checkmate needed.

name: Antichess
desc: Captures are mandatory. Lose all your pieces to win.

name: Racing Kings
desc: No checks allowed. Race your king to rank 8.

name: Fischer Random
desc: 960 possible starting positions. King between rooks.

name: Rifle Chess
desc: Capturing pieces stay on their original square.

name: Marseillais
desc: Two moves per turn. Check ends your turn early.

name: Duck Chess
desc: Place a blocker duck after each move. Capture the king to win.

name: Fog of War
desc: You only see squares your pieces can reach.

name: Capablanca
desc: Archbishop and Chancellor on a wider board.

name: Grand Chess
desc: Same new pieces, bigger board, pawns start on rank 3.
